FINE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: FINE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

====

1. B — The speed of the music

2. C — Practise Drawing ● Elements and principles of 2- dimensional Art ● linear perspective ● o with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. A — Practise Painting ● wash technique ● painting sceneries ● painting composition using brus with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. A — Practise Graphic Design 2.2 Fabric decoration: Tie and dye 2.3 Fabric decoration: Batik 3 with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. D — Practise Pottery 3.2 Sculpture 3.3 Macramé 3.4 Jewellery and Ornamentation 3.5 Art Apprec with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. B — Practise Fabric decoration: Batik 3.0 Indigenous Crafts 3.1 Pottery 3.2 Sculpture 3.3 Mac with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. C — Practise Pottery and Ceramics ● Clay ● Elements of 3- D Art (texture, colour, voids, soli with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. A — Practise Graphic Design ● Trademark ● An educational/ social/ /advertisement poster. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. B — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

12. C — Practise Collage ● type of collage; single-media and mixed media collage ● characteristic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Art Appreciation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Drawing ● Elements and principles of 2- dimensional Art ● linear perspective ● o; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
